desc: FreeRDP versions from 2.0.0 before 3.32.0 contain a heap out-of-bounds write in the server hash-callback NTLM path that fails to validate the MIC offset. Unauthenticated attackers can send a crafted AUTHENTICATE_MESSAGE with a backward session-key offset and MIC offset to write 16 zero bytes beyond the allocation.

title: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta Stored XSS via SVG Upload Sanitizer Bypass
desc: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in SvgSanitizer that allows FAQ editors to store executable SVG files. Attackers can split script tags around removed tokens like processing instructions so single-pass removal reassembles them, executing script in the application origin when victims open the file.

title: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta Authorization Bypass via Comments and Attachments API
desc: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in isFaqAccessibleForUser() that treats a missing FAQ translation as visible to unauthenticated users. Attackers can send a mismatched Accept-Language header to the comments and attachments API endpoints to read comments and attachment listings of unpublished or ACL-restricted FAQs.

title: phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 CSRF via /admin/api/update-database
desc: phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the POST /admin/api/update-database endpoint, which executes database migrations without validating a CSRF token. Attackers can lure a logged-in user with the CONFIGURATION_EDIT permission into submitting a crafted cross-site request, triggering migrations that may impact database integrity or availability.

title: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.16 IDOR via Forum Topic Update
desc: Admidio from 5.0.0 before 5.0.16 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in ForumService::saveTopic() that allows authenticated members to modify other users' forum topics. Attackers can replace the topic_uuid parameter in their own topic_save request, reusing their CSRF token, to overwrite the victim topic's title and first post.

title: Yank Note before 3.93.1 Path Traversal via /api/help Endpoint
desc: Yank Note before 3.93.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read arbitrary files via the path or doc parameter of /api/help. Attackers can supply repeated '../' segments, which bypass the single-replacement sanitization in the publicly allowlisted endpoint, to read SSH keys, configuration, or notes.

title: Fleet before 4.89.0 Unauthenticated DoS via Apple MDM Enrollment Plist Parsing
desc: Fleet before 4.89.0 contains an unbounded recursion vulnerability in Apple MDM enrollment property list parsing that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the server. Attackers can send a crafted binary plist payload of about 150 bytes to the enrollment endpoints, triggering exponential allocation or infinite recursion that exhausts CPU and memory.

title: Coder 2.30.0 before 2.34.8 Cross-Organization File Disclosure via DownloadFile RPC
desc: Coder from 2.30.0 before 2.34.8 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the provisioner daemon DownloadFile gRPC handler that allows authenticated provisioner daemons to download other organizations' cached Terraform module archives. Attackers with an org-scoped provisioner key and a known file UUID can retrieve module source code exposing infrastructure topology or embedded secrets.

desc: Coder before 2.34.7 contains an IP spoofing vulnerability in the ExtractRealIPAddress middleware that trusts the leftmost, client-supplied X-Forwarded-For value instead of the client IP appended by a reverse proxy. title: ProjectSend 2.5.0 before 2.7.0 Unverified Password Change via /settings/password
desc: ProjectSend 2.5.0 before 2.7.0 contains an unverified password change vulnerability in PasswordController::update() that lets sessions of Social-provisioned accounts set local passwords without the current password. Attackers holding a stolen session cookie can send PUT /settings/password to create a durable local password, enroll their own second factor, and persistently take over the account.

Attackers can supply a crafted .ult module that overwrites the instruments pointer array, causing csf_destroy() to free attacker-chosen pointers and crash the application.

title: libtta through 2.3 Integer Overflow via tta_decoder_init_get_info Seek Table
desc: libtta through 2.3 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in tta_decoder_init_get_info() that allows attackers to cause a heap buffer overflow on 32-bit builds via unvalidated header fields. Attackers can supply a crafted .tta file with a sample rate of 1 and large samples value, wrapping the seek table allocation and crashing applications.

title: libtta through 2.3 Stack Out-of-Bounds Write via Zero Channel Count
desc: libtta through 2.3 contains a stack out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in tta_decoder_process_stream() and tta_decoder_process_frame() because header checks never reject a zero channel count. Attackers can supply a crafted .tta file declaring zero channels so decorrelation accesses cache[-1] with stream-derived values, corrupting stack memory in decoding applications.

title: OW2 ASM 9.11 before 9.11.1 Denial of Service via Infinite Loop in Label.resolve()
desc: OW2 ASM 9.11 before 9.11.1 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in Label.resolve() caused by 16-bit forward-reference offsets truncating when rewritten methods exceed 64 KB. Attackers can supply crafted class files whose transformed code grows past 65535 bytes, hanging ClassReader.accept() and denying service to build tools, instrumenters, agents, or analyzers.

desc: Gitify before 7.10.0 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to bind a victim's client to their account because performGitHubWebOAuth() omits OAuth state validation. title: Xinference through 4.0.1 Path Traversal via model_name in Custom Model Registration
desc: Xinference through 4.0.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability on Windows that allows unauthenticated attackers to write and delete arbitrary .json files via backslash sequences in model_name. Attackers can register a persisted custom model through POST /v1/model_registrations/{model_type} with names like ..\..\evil to overwrite configuration or data files writable by the Xinference process.

title: wvWare wv through 1.2.9 Stack Out-of-Bounds Read via wvGetPAPX_FKP and wvGetCHPX_FKP
desc: wvWare wv through 1.2.9 contains a stack-based out-of-bounds read vulnerability in wvGetPAPX_FKP and wvGetCHPX_FKP caused by an unvalidated FKP run count. Attackers can supply a crafted .doc file with a large crun value to read kilobytes past the 512-byte stack buffer, crashing applications like AbiWord.

title: wvWare wv through 1.2.9 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via wvGetSTSH
desc: wvWare wv through 1.2.9 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds read vulnerability in wvGetSTSH in stylesheet.c that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying crafted Word stylesheets. Attackers can provide a .doc file with ten or fewer styles or out-of-range style base indexes to read past heap arrays, crashing applications such as AbiWord.

title: librtmp (RTMPDump) through 2.6 Heap Out-of-Bounds Write via AMF3_Decode
desc: librtmp in RTMPDump through 2.6 contains an out-of-bounds read and heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability because AMF3_Decode ignores AMF3 property decode failures. Malicious RTMP servers or man-in-the-middle attackers can send oversized AMF3 string lengths, and with the token option DecodeTEA corrupts heap memory and leaks heap bytes.

title: librtmp (RTMPDump) through 2.6 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via AMFProp_Decode
desc: librtmp (RTMPDump) through 2.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in AMFProp_Decode that reads an AMF0 strict-array element count before checking that four bytes remain. desc: A flaw was found in RESTEasy's IIOImageProvider, which decodes attacker-supplied image request bodies without enforcing any limit on the declared image dimensions or pixel count. desc: A Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input vulnerability in the routing protocol daemon (rpd) of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an adjacent unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial of service via a malformed RSVP packet when RSVP is enabled on the receiving interface.

desc: In Eclipse Vert.x versions [4.0.0, 4.5.34] or [5.0.0,5.0.12] or [5.1.0,5.1.9] or [5.2.0, 5.2.0], a scope bypass vulnerability exists in Eclipse Vert.x Web's ChainAuthHandler when used with scope-requiring authentication handlers such as JWTAuthHandler or OAuth2AuthHandler. desc: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. desc: Sungrow iSolarCloud before 2026-08-25 allows authentication bypass and account takeover via "login_type":"5" in a login request, potentially leading to "local blackouts on the whole continent" in Europe. desc: ERPNext is a free and open source Enterprise Resource Planning tool. Prior to 15.121.0 and 16.34.0, certain endpoints for status modification fail to enforce proper authorization checks. desc: @fastify/oauth2 is a Fastify wrapper for OAuth2 login flows. desc: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key vulnerability in Liquid Web / StellarWP Event Tickets event-tickets allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Event Tickets: from n/a through 5.30.1.

desc: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in E2Pdf.com e2pdf e2pdf allows Stored XSS.This issue affects e2pdf: from n/a through 1.32.57.

desc: Fuint through commit 57ec018 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated members to read other members' booking records by supplying arbitrary bookId values to /clientApi/book/myBookDetail. desc: Arkon through 0.9.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in GET /api/wiki/graph that lets authenticated employees read other departments' wiki metadata by supplying a foreign slug. Administrators holding USER_EDIT can submit language-scoped rights to the update-rights API, including for themselves, to gain unrestricted FAQ create, edit, and publish access across all languages.

title: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta Unauthenticated DoS via API Pagination
desc: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the unauthenticated faqs and search API endpoints. Attackers can send concurrent GET requests that load and process all database records into PHP memory, exhausting CPU and memory to crash the server.

desc: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the Elasticsearch and OpenSearch administration API endpoints, which do not validate a CSRF token for the create, drop, and import actions. desc: phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability where WebAuthn registration endpoints attach credentials to any account without authentication or challenge validation. Attackers can stage a victim username, submit a forged fmt=none attestation to register a passkey, then log in bypassing passwords and TOTP for account takeover.

title: Mopidy before 4.0.5 Path Traversal via File Backend library.lookup
desc: Mopidy before 4.0.5 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated clients to access local files outside file/media_dirs because FileLibraryProvider.lookup() lacks a containment check. Attackers can call core.library.lookup or core.tracklist.add over JSON-RPC or WebSocket with file:// URIs to probe file existence, read tag metadata, and play out-of-sandbox files.

title: Frappe Helpdesk before 1.26.0 Authorization Bypass via raised_by in Ticket Creation
desc: Frappe Helpdesk before 1.26.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated portal users to create tickets impersonating other customers by supplying a raised_by value. Attackers can call the hd_ticket.api.new endpoint with a victim's email to plant phishing tickets in their portal and read their replies via get_ticket_activities.

title: SGLang through 0.5.22 Cross-Request Abort via rid Prefix Matching
desc: SGLang through 0.5.22 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows API clients to abort other users' in-flight generation requests by supplying a short client-controlled rid. Attackers can submit streaming /generate requests with single hex character rids and disconnect, triggering prefix-matching abort logic that terminates all other clients' requests.

title: libdisplay-info through 0.4.0 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via DisplayID v1 Parser
desc: libdisplay-info through 0.4.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the DisplayID v1 section parser in displayid.c that occurs when a data block's declared length exceeds the section. Attackers can supply a crafted EDID from a malicious monitor, KVM, capture device, or EDID file to make is_all_zeroes read past the buffer, causing a possible crash.

title: Krayin CRM before 2.2.7 IDOR via Quote Search and Lead-Products Endpoints
desc: Krayin CRM before 2.2.7 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows scope-restricted authenticated users to read other users' quotes by bypassing per-user data scope checks in QuoteController. Attackers can query the quotes search and lead-products endpoints to retrieve quote addresses, totals, contact details, and product pricing belonging to any user or lead.

title: Flarum Extension Manager 2.0.0-beta.1 before 2.0.0-beta.8 Missing Authorization via Task API
desc: Flarum Extension Manager 2.0.0-beta.1 before 2.0.0-beta.8 lacks authentication and admin checks on the TaskResource index endpoint, allowing unauthenticated information disclosure. Remote attackers can send GET requests to /api/extension-manager-tasks to read task output revealing filesystem paths, installed extensions, versions, and PHP version.

title: FlyCms through commit edfdf724 Default Super Administrator Credentials
desc: FlyCms through commit edfdf724 contains a default credentials vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain super administrator access via the flycms account with password admin123. Attackers can log in through POST /api/auth/login, solving only the image captcha, to obtain full control of site content, users and configuration.

title: IBM i is Affected By An Improper Authentication Vulnerability in SST / DST
desc: IBM i 7.3, 7.4, 7.5, and 7.6 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security restrictions due to improper authentication.

desc: IBM i 7.3, 7.4, 7.5, and 7.6 is could allow a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security restrictions due to improper enforcement of the ChrootDirectory configuration directive.

desc: A flaw was found in libtirpc. desc: Uncontrolled recursion in the SVG parser and renderer of the Qt SVG module (QtSvg) in Qt Group Qt allows attackers to cause a denial of service (application crash via stack exhaustion) via a crafted SVG file with deeply nested elements.

desc: 10up Distributor before 2.3.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ajax_push() that allows Contributor-level multisite users to publish posts on other network sites. Attackers can use the dt-push nonce with a chosen connection id and postStatus to create draft or published posts on sites they cannot access.

title: abp-next-admin 10.2.0 through 10.6.0 IDOR in AIManagement Chat Conversations
desc: abp-next-admin 10.2.0 through 10.6.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the LINGYUN.Abp.AIManagement module that allows authenticated users to access other users' AI chat conversations by supplying their ConversationId. desc: Helical Insight through 7.0.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated viewers to read files outside the solution directory via the path parameter of /getExternalResource. desc: DooTask through 1.9.66 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in WebSocketDialog::checkDialog() that skips the membership check for dialogs with group_type 'okr'. Authenticated users can supply the dialog_id of OKR comment dialogs to msg__list, msg__one, or msg__send* endpoints to read and inject messages.

title: MrDoc through 1.1.1 Missing Authorization via api/import_local_doc/ Endpoint
desc: MrDoc through 1.1.1 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability in the ImportLocalDoc API that allows authenticated users to modify other users' documents and projects. Attackers can send PUT requests with arbitrary sort_data document ids to publish private drafts and reparent documents, or POST with arbitrary top_doc ids to inject documents.

desc: ChronoFrame through 1.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the server/api/wizard/ handlers that allows unauthenticated attackers to reconfigure already configured instances. desc: ThinkAdmin think-plugs-admin through 1.0.81 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows non-super administrators to read and overwrite other administrators' file records via admin/file.edit. desc: waynboot-mall through 2.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to cancel any member's pending order via the /callback/order/unpaid endpoint. desc: IceCMS through 4.1.5 contains an unauthenticated sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject SQL by supplying a crafted num path parameter to /WebResource/findresourcebynum. Attackers can append SQL after the LIMIT clause concatenated via QueryWrapper.last() to extract database contents using union-based or blind techniques.

desc: Simple Admin Core through 1.8.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge super administrator tokens by using the hard-coded Auth.AccessSecret in api/etc/core.yaml. desc: The ElementsReady Addons for Elementor WordPress plugin through 6.7.2 does not perform authorization checks that halt execution in several of its settings-save handlers, allowing users with subscriber-level access and above to overwrite the ElementsReady Addons for Elementor WordPress plugin through 6.7.2's stored settings, including its stored API credentials and its feature and template configur

title: ElementsReady Addons for Elementor <= 6.7.2 - Unauthenticated Paid Download Access Bypass via 'downloadtype' Parameter
desc: The ElementsReady Addons for Elementor WordPress plugin through 6.7.2 does not properly restrict access to protected WooCommerce product downloads, allowing unauthenticated users to bypass the payment requirement and retrieve any product's paid downloadable file.

title: Subscribe to Comments 2.3 - 2.3.2 - Author+ Email Header Injection via From Name Setting
desc: The Subscribe to Comments WordPress plugin before 2.3.3 does not sanitise newline characters from a notification sender-name setting before using it in e-mail headers, allowing users with Author-level access and above to inject arbitrary e-mail headers, such as a hidden Bcc, and to spoof the sender.

title: TrueBooker Appointment Booking 1.1.9 - 1.2.9 - Unauthenticated Plugin Settings Overwrite via admin_setting_setup_data
desc: The TrueBooker WordPress plugin before 1.3.0 does not perform any capability check on one of its setup handlers, and the token it does check is issued to unauthenticated visitors, allowing anyone to overwrite the plugin's entire configuration and to discard any setting they do not supply.

title: TrueBooker Appointment Booking 1.1.9 - 1.2.9 - Unauthenticated Customer PII Disclosure via IDOR in 'refappbkd' Parameter
desc: The TrueBooker WordPress plugin before 1.3.0 does not verify that the requester owns a booking before rendering its confirmation summary, allowing unauthenticated attackers to enumerate booking identifiers and retrieve the personal information of customers who booked an appointment, as well as invalidate the customer's own confirmation link.

title: TrueBooker Appointment Booking 1.1.9 - 1.2.9 - Unauthenticated Booking Creation with Arbitrary Price via Multiple AJAX Actions
desc: The TrueBooker WordPress plugin before 1.3.0 does not have authorisation checks in some of its AJAX actions, and does not validate the submitted service price server-side, allowing unauthenticated users to create bookings at a price of their choosing and to attach them to arbitrary customer accounts.

title: TrueBooker Appointment Booking 1.1.9 - 1.2.9 - Unauthenticated Service and Category Creation and Modification
desc: The TrueBooker WordPress plugin before 1.3.0 does not have authorisation checks in place in some of its functionality, allowing unauthenticated users to create and modify booking services and categories, including their prices.

title: Snap Finance 1.0.8 - 3.11.0 - Unauthenticated Arbitrary Order Status Change via Multiple AJAX Actions
desc: The Snap Finance WordPress plugin before 3.12.0 does not verify that a request to change a WooCommerce order's status comes from an authorised source, allowing unauthenticated attackers to move any order into a paid state or force it to fail.

title: Snap Finance <= 3.11.0 - Unauthenticated Payment Confirmation Forgery via snap_finance_complete_payment
desc: The Snap Finance WordPress plugin through 3.11.0 does not verify that the payment provider's response actually confirms a completed, approved transaction before marking a WooCommerce order as paid, allowing unauthenticated attackers to mark arbitrary orders as paid without completing payment.

title: App Builder 3.8.4 - 5.7.0 - Unauthenticated Option Write and Redirect via includes/pure.php
desc: The App Builder WordPress plugin before 5.7.1 does not require authentication or authorisation before writing attacker-supplied data to one of its options and, on a separate unauthenticated request, redirecting the visitor's browser to a URI built from that stored data.

title: Libsoup: libsoup: heap buffer overflow from websocket pong signal type confusion
desc: A flaw was found in libsoup. When handling an incoming WebSocket Pong frame, SoupWebsocketConnection emitted the ::pong signal with a GByteArray pointer even though the signal is declared to pass a GBytes. title: Libsoup: libsoup: heap buffer overflow during websocket message reassembly
desc: A flaw was found in libsoup. When reassembling fragmented WebSocket messages into a GByteArray, libsoup did not adequately cap total message size against the limits of the underlying buffer type. A remote peer could send fragments that caused size truncation while the implementation still used the full length, leading to heap corruption or a crash.

title: Libsoup: libsoup: heap buffer overflow during websocket receive-buffer growth

title: Libsoup: libsoup: heap buffer overflow during websocket client-frame masking

title: Rsyslog: rsyslog: denial of service via heap buffer overflow in rainerscript replace() function
desc: A flaw was found in rsyslog. An unauthenticated remote attacker can trigger a heap buffer overflow in the RainerScript `replace()` function by sending specially crafted syslog messages. Successful exploitation can lead to a denial of service (DoS) for the affected system.

title: FreeRDP before 3.32.0 Out-of-Bounds Write via MS-RDPEGT Video Geometry

A malicious RDP server can send a negative topLevelLeft to clients connecting with /video, causing an out-of-bounds write of decoded H.264 picture data or a client abort.

title: Appointment Booking Plugin <= 5.7.4 - Unauthenticated Authentication Bypass via Race Condition on OTP Attempts Counter
desc: The Appointment Booking Plugin – LatePoint | Calendar & Scheduling for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass via Race Condition in all versions up to, and including, 5.7.4. This is due to a non-atomic read-modify-write on the OTP verification attempts counter in the `verifyOTP` function: the counter is incremented using a stale in-memory value with no conditional `W

title: WordPress SMS Alert Order Notifications plugin <= 4.0.1 - Broken Access Control vulnerability
desc: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Cozy Vision Technologies Pvt. Ltd. SMS Alert Order Notifications sms-alert allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects SMS Alert Order Notifications: from n/a through 4.0.1.

title: Themify Builder <= 7.8.2 - Authenticated (Contributor+) Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'visible' Shortcode Attribute
desc: The Themify Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'visible' Shortcode Attribute in all versions up to, and including, 7.8.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses

title: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta Missing Current-Password Step-Up on E-mail Change Enables Account Takeover
desc: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta does not require the current password when changing an account e-mail in the user control panel (UserController::updateData, api/user/data/update), checking only the session and CSRF token. An attacker with a hijacked session can set the e-mail to their own mailbox and use the password-reset flow to take over non-2FA accounts, including super

title: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta Missing Authorization via deleteGroup API
desc: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a missing authorization vulnerability in GroupController::deleteGroup() that omits privilege-level checks on target groups. Authenticated non-SuperAdmin administrators holding GROUP_DELETE can send a crafted groupId to /admin/api/group/delete to permanently destroy higher-privileged groups and strip members' inherited rights.

title: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-beta 2FA Brute-Force via remove-twofactor Endpoint
desc: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-beta lacks brute-force lockout in the removeTwofactorConfig() 2FA removal endpoint, allowing authenticated attackers to guess TOTP codes without limit. Attackers holding a hijacked session and CSRF token can repeatedly POST guesses to /api/user/remove-twofactor to permanently disable the victim's 2FA.

title: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta Account Enumeration via Guest Comment Endpoint
desc: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an account enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to confirm registered display names and emails via a distinct HTTP 409 response. Attackers can submit guest comments to the comment create endpoint with candidate user and mail values to link names to emails for targeted phishing.

title: phpMyFAQ 4.1.0 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta Missing Authorization via Admin Dashboard
desc: phpMyFAQ from 4.1.0 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the admin dashboard that allows authenticated users without admin rights to view restricted data. Attackers with any activated account can request /admin/index.php/ to read unpublished FAQ questions, admin edit URLs, recent user identities, and site statistics.

title: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta Privilege Escalation via Group Category Restrictions API
desc: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in GroupController::saveCategoryRestrictions() that lets delegated administrators assign categories outside their own scope. Category-restricted administrators can POST to /admin/api/group/category-restrictions with out-of-scope or empty categoryIds to grant groups unrestricted category access.

title: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta Information Disclosure via open-questions API
desc: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read hidden open questions due to an inverted api.onlyPublicQuestions check in OpenQuestionController. Attackers can send GET requests to the /api/v4.0/open-questions endpoint to retrieve non-public moderation or internal questions and their associated usernames.

title: Vikunja 2.6.0 Broken Access Control via Inherited Project Permissions
desc: Vikunja 2.6.0 contains a broken access control flaw in getProjectAccessForUser (pkg/models/project_access.go), which resolves a user's effective project permission as the maximum over the project tree, silently overriding explicit lower-permission shares on sub-projects. A collaborator with write access on a parent project but read-only access to a child project can modify the child project's task

title: Gitea reusable workflow secret exposure in pull_request_target
desc: Gitea resolves local reusable workflow files from a fork's head commit when a trusted base-branch workflow runs for a pull_request_target event. A fork author can modify a referenced reusable workflow so attacker-controlled code executes with the repository and organization secrets available to that event. Exploitation requires a base workflow that calls a local reusable workflow, and bypasses the

title: BSK PDF Manager <= 3.8.1 - Contributor+ SQLi via tags_specific Shortcode Attribute
desc: The BSK PDF Manager WordPress plugin through 3.8.1 does not properly sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, which could allow authenticated users with contributor-level access and above to perform SQL injection attacks and read sensitive data such as administrator password hashes from the database.

title: ThirstyAffiliates < 3.12.1 - Unauthenticated Non-Public Affiliate Link Destination Disclosure and Click Statistic Injection
desc: The ThirstyAffiliates  WordPress plugin before 3.12.1 does not check the status or type of the object requested by its link redirect tracking handler, allowing unauthenticated attackers to disclose the destination URLs of unpublished affiliate links and to record fabricated click statistics.

title: HTTP/2 upload Use-After-Free
desc:
During an upload, curl mishandles HTTP/2 `RST_STREAM` received from the server
(with reason `HTTP_1_1_REQUIRED` or `REFUSED_STREAM`) leading to a use after
free of a `struct Curl_easy` object.

title: An issue was discovered in HAProxy before 3.3.6. The HTTP/3 parser does not check that the received body length matches
desc: An issue was discovered in HAProxy before 3.3.6. The HTTP/3 parser does not check that the received body length matches a previously announced content-length when the stream is closed via a frame with an empty payload. This can cause desynchronization issues with the backend server and could be used for request smuggling. The earliest affected version is 2.6.

title: Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved: An attacker causes a routing-daemon crash when BGP ISO-VPN egress protection is enabled
desc: A NULL Pointer Dereference vulnerability in the rpd routing daemon of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an unauthenticated configured BGP peer to cause a denial of service via a BGP UPDATE when ISO-VPN and egress-protection configuration is enabled.

title: Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved: An attacker causes an rpd crash when routing-policy resolution-map processing and policy event tracing are enabled
desc: A NULL Pointer Dereference vulnerability in the routing protocol daemon (rpd) of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows a configured BGP neighbor to cause a denial of service via a BGP route update when specific routing-policy resolution-map and policy event-tracing configuration is enabled.

title: Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved: An attacker causes rpd denial of service when EVPN route signaling is used
desc: An Improper Handling of Length Parameter Inconsistency vulnerability in the routing protocol daemon (rpd) process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an unauthenticated network-based attacker to cause a denial of service via a malformed EVPN Type-3 or Type-4 route received from a configured EVPN peer and processed during re-advertisement.

title: Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved: An attacker causes rpd crash and denial of service when EVPN is configured
desc: An Improper Input Validation vulnerability in the routing protocol daemon (rpd) of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an unauthenticated network-based attacker to cause a denial of service via a crafted BGP EVPN update message.

title: svg-sanitizer: Mixed-case xlink:HrEf skips the `<use>` nesting-DoS check in Resolver::processReferences
desc: svg-sanitizer is a PHP SVG/XML sanitizer. Prior to 1.0.0, Resolver::processReferences() in src/ElementReference/Resolver.php builds the SVG <use> reference graph with a case-sensitive href attribute predicate before cleanHrefAttributes() normalizes mixed-case names. An attacker can provide xlink:HrEf on nested <use> elements so the graph omits those references, after which the sanitizer converts t

title: Epic Games Unreal Engine Insecure Default URL Scheme Allowance in LaunchURL
desc: Epic Games Unreal Engine versions up to and including 5.8.0 ship with an insecure default configuration for the LaunchURL Blueprint node (UKismetSystemLibrary::LaunchURL). The URL scheme filter (FURLRequestFilter) is empty by default, which permits all URL schemes. On Windows, this results in a call to ShellExecuteW() with the open verb, so a supplied file:/// URI causes the referenced file to be

title: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output in Crafty Controller
desc: An output escaping vulnerability in the Audit Logs component of Crafty Controller allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to perform stored cross-site scripting via HTTP header injection

title: Gitea GitLab migration denial of service
desc: Gitea's initial GitLab migration version probe uses an HTTP client without a timeout and does not attach the migration task's cancellation context. An authenticated user who can start migrations can target an attacker-controlled server that keeps the response open indefinitely. The request continues after task cancellation and can exhaust the migration worker pool, preventing other migrations from

title: Gitea organization repository creation token scope bypass
desc: Gitea's organization repository-creation API requires write:organization but omits the write:repository token scope enforced by other repository-creation routes. A personal access token or OAuth application token without repository-write scope can therefore create organization-owned repositories if the authorizing user has permission to do so. This bypasses the token's delegated scope boundary whi

title: Gitea second-factor bypass through OpenID identity linking
desc: Gitea's OpenID connect handler accepts a user's password without enforcing enrolled TOTP or WebAuthn verification before completing sign-in and linking an OpenID identifier. When OpenID sign-in is enabled, an attacker who knows the victim's password can obtain a session and link an attacker-controlled identifier. The attacker can then sign in through that identifier without the victim's password o

title: Gitea external renderer argument injection and code execution
desc: Gitea substitutes a URL derived from the markup Context field into external renderer command templates without escaping the reference path before shell-style argument splitting. A crafted Context can inject additional renderer arguments, including options that load executable filter files. On deployments using a susceptible external renderer such as pandoc, a user who can place a filter file at an

title: Gitea Runner host isolation bypass through container options
desc: Gitea Runner passes workflow-controlled container options into Docker job container configuration while privileged mode is disabled. Host namespace settings, expanded capabilities, and security profile overrides can remain effective despite Privileged being forced false. A workflow author able to run jobs on an affected Docker-backed runner can use these options to access host namespaces and execu

title: Gitea API token scope escalation through HTTP signatures
desc: Gitea allows a token with write:user scope to register an attacker-controlled SSH public key on the token owner's account. API requests signed with the corresponding private key authenticate as that account through HTTP Signature without API token scope information, causing route-level token scope checks to be skipped. This converts a user-scoped token into an unscoped API authentication method wh

title: Gitea repository ownership escalation by administrators
desc: Gitea's collaboration access-mode endpoint accepts the Owner access mode from an authenticated repository collaborator with Admin access. The collaborator can promote their effective permissions from Admin to Owner and then perform owner-only operations, including transferring the repository to their own account. This bypasses the intended boundary between repository administration and ownership.

title: Dell Terraform Provider for Redfish, versions 1.1.0 through 1.6.1, contains an Exposure of Sensitive Information to an U
desc: Dell Terraform Provider for Redfish, versions 1.1.0 through 1.6.1, contains an Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor vulnerability in the redfish_certificate resource component. A high privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure.

title: Gitea blind SSRF through OpenID assertion verification
desc: When OpenID sign-in is enabled, Gitea processes unauthenticated assertion parameters and sends an HTTP POST request to the caller-supplied OpenID provider endpoint during verification. An attacker controls the destination and much of the form body, allowing interaction with internal HTTP services reachable from the Gitea server. The response is not returned to the attacker, so the issue is blind S

title: Gitea private attachment disclosure through repository mismatch
desc: Gitea's web attachment handler skips its cross-repository ownership check for attachments created before 16 January 2026 and checks permissions against the repository named in the request URL instead. An unauthenticated attacker who knows a private attachment's UUID can request it through a public repository's attachment path and retrieve its contents. This can expose issue and pull request attach

desc:
Insecure Temporary File vulnerability in Hitachi Disk Array Driver for AIX and Hitachi Disk Array Driver for Virtual I/O Server.

This issue affects Hitachi Disk Array Driver for AIX: from 01-00 before 01-23-/A; Hitachi Disk Array Driver for Virtual I/O Server: from 01-04 before 01-23-/A.

desc: OpenVPN 2.7_alpha1 through 2.7.7 allows remote authenticated users to impersonate others via a crafted certificate subject field

desc:
Out-of-bounds write vulnerability in Hitachi Disk Array Driver for AIX and Hitachi Disk Array Driver for Virtual I/O Server.
